summary: Wooden tower near Woodward, Centre County, reported in 1919; a Forest Lookouts listing marks it removed, with no date.

facts.status_note: The Forest Lookouts listing marks the tower as removed. No removal date is given.

events.note: A 1919 Forest Leaves item says another wooden tower had been erected near Woodward. A 1918-19 report already names the Woodward tower, so the build may be earlier.
A June 1920 newspaper item describes a plan to add a stairway. It is a plan only, and the page does not confirm the stairway was built.

notes_for_editor: Single source. The Forest Lookouts page quotes three historical items (a 1918-19 state report, a 1919 Forest Leaves item and a June 1920 Lewisburg Journal item) and ends with a Removed line. Two WebSearch calls and three page reads found no other record of a fire tower at Woodward in Centre County. The brief coordinates (40.9177, -77.3318) are not verified. Another Woodward in Clearfield County appeared in search results and should not be confused with this one. The build year is unclear: the 1919 item says a tower had been erected, but the 1918-19 report already refers to the Woodward tower. Editor should decide whether one source is enough to publish.
